description: Codex equivalents of shared lifecycle hooks in .claude/settings.json.

hooks.command: if [ -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plans/NEXT.md" ]; then head -c 2000 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plans/NEXT.md"; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $projectRoot = (git rev-parse --show-toplevel).Trim(); $handoff = Join-Path $projectRoot 'plans/NEXT.md'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $handoff) { $content = Get-Content -LiteralPath $handoff -Raw -Encoding utf8; if ($content) { $content.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(2000, $content.Length)) } }
